description: Bash status script. #!/bin/bash. For each daemon (mcp_scanner,signal_analyser,trust_synthesiser,threat_intel_ingestor,risk_ranker,attestation_engine,approval_workflow,registry_api,search_api): check if pgrep -f <daemon>.py returns a PID. Print [OK] PID or [--] not running. Then curl -s http://localhost:<port>/health for API services. Print summary: N/M services running. Also print last 3 lines of each log file.
